defects.summary: digest() defaults now to datetime.now(), a naive local time, and compares it with the timezone-aware due datetimes: calling digest(days) without now raises TypeError (and would be off by the UTC offset if it did not).
The digest window is closed at the end ('<= end') although the task says a reminder due exactly at now + days is excluded; due_between right above already has the correct half-open test.

test_digest_end_is_exclusive looks up the key '2026-03-03' (the edge reminder is on 2026-03-02) with .get(..., []) and all() over the result, so it passes whether or not the end instant is excluded; the boundary bug goes unnoticed.

decoys.summary: Naive text is given the agenda timezone with replace(tzinfo=...) rather than astimezone(): the text is a wall-clock time in that zone, so replace is the correct operation.
EARLIEST is datetime.min made aware so overdue() can reuse due_between; it is only ever compared, never converted, so it cannot overflow.
